【起因与机理】检索算法对源站真实性鉴别能力缺失，以及对非主流品牌数据抓取的合规盲区
【关键数据与实测】IP保护机构Podqi对主流AI模型（Gemini, Perplexity, ChatGPT）的购物检索能力进行测试，发现高达15%的对话结果中包含风险URL。

summary_en: Security researchers discovered over 35,000 apps built via Grok are publicly accessible without authentication. author: New York Times
content_snippet: Silicon Valley has a special talent for offering amazing products and then screwing them up with ridiculous ideas about how those products should be used.
summary_en: VR pioneer Jaron Lanier argues that Silicon Valley is sabotaging itself through poor AI marketing and designating local areas as 'sacrifice zones' for data centers. He contends that Big Tech companies are failing to articulate the value of AI while ignoring the environmental and social costs of their massive infrastructure projects.
title_zh: 虚拟现实先驱怒批硅谷AI叙事
summary_zh: VR先驱贾隆·拉尼尔批评硅谷AI推广策略极其失败，且在疯狂压榨社区资源建设数据中心

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 虚拟现实先驱贾隆·拉尼尔指出，硅谷正在通过拙劣的AI营销和将特定区域划为数据中心“牺牲区”来自我毁灭。拉尼尔认为，大厂在向公众兜售AI价值时表现极其笨拙，同时无视数据中心建设对当地生态与社区的负面代价。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: VR pioneer Jaron Lanier argues that Silicon Valley is sabotaging itself through poor AI marketing and designating local areas as 'sacrifice zones' for data centers. He contends that Big Tech companies are failing to articulate the value of AI while ignoring the environmental and social costs of their massive infrastructure projects.

fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】VR先驱贾隆·拉尼尔在针对硅谷AI行业发展的公开评论：批评科技巨头在AI推销上策略极其拙劣，且将数据中心所在地当成可随意牺牲的工业废地。
【起因与机理】对AI商业化狂热背后的资源掠夺及叙事脱节感到不满。
【核心事实细节】VR先驱对硅谷AI策略提出严厉警告。
【核心诉求与态度】认为这种短视行为正在摧毁硅谷的公众信任。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] VR pioneer Jaron Lanier: Criticized the tech industry's poor AI pitching and the treatment of data center sites as expendable 'sacrifice zones'.
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Frustrated by the industry's disconnect with the public and the unchecked ecological toll of AI infrastructure.
[Key Fact Detail] VR pioneer issues a stern warning against Silicon Valley's AI strategy.
[Key Position & Outlook] Arguing this short-sighted approach is eroding public trust.

title: Nintendo Sold 5.2 Million Copies of ‘Zelda’ Remake in Four Days
title_en: Nintendo Sold 5.2 Million Copies of ‘Zelda’ Remake in Four Days
author: Vlad Savov
content_snippet: Nintendo Co. sold 5.2 million copies of its The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake in just four days …
summary_en: Nintendo released the remake of 'The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time', hitting 5.2 million copies sold within just four days of its launch. This monumental performance serves as a massive endorsement for Nintendo's upcoming Switch 2, proving that classic IP power remains the ultimate system seller.

fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】任天堂在全球游戏市场：发布《塞尔达传说：时之笛》重制版，四天售出520万份
【起因与机理】借经典大作余威，为下一代主机Switch 2上市造势并夯实装机基础

[Key Fact Detail] Nintendo released a classic remake.
[Key Position & Outlook] Strategic leverage for Switch 2 launch.

title: The Nvidia spy scandal exposes networks operating in Singapore that help Chinese tech companies access advanced US AI chips and circumvent export controls (Owen Walker/Financial Times)
title_en: The Nvidia spy scandal exposes networks operating in Singapore that help Chinese tech companies access advanced US AI chips and circumvent export controls (Owen Walker/Financial Times)
author: Financial Times
content_snippet: A suspected Chinese spy and Singaporean chip deal reveal the Asian networks testing Washington's grip on AI technology
summary_en: A suspected Chinese intelligence operative has been exposed for utilizing a complex network in Singapore to help Chinese tech firms procure restricted high-end Nvidia AI chips. The operation aimed to bypass U.S. export controls by rerouting prohibited semiconductor technology through Singaporean intermediaries.
title_zh: 英伟达芯片走私暗网在新加坡曝光
summary_zh: 一起涉及中国间谍的芯片走私案被揭露，新加坡成美限制级AI芯片流入中国的重要中转枢纽

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 一名被怀疑为中国从事间谍活动的涉案者，利用新加坡作为掩护，搭建复杂的物流网络，协助中国科技公司获取受美方出口管制的高端英伟达AI芯片。此举旨在规避美国政府对华半导体禁运政策，通过复杂的贸易路径将芯片绕道运往受限地区。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: A suspected Chinese intelligence operative has been exposed for utilizing a complex network in Singapore to help Chinese tech firms procure restricted high-end Nvidia AI chips. The operation aimed to bypass U.S. export controls by rerouting prohibited semiconductor technology through Singaporean intermediaries.

fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】涉案间谍及新加坡相关物流网络在新加坡贸易转运网络：通过非法渠道走私美制高端AI芯片至中国
【起因与机理】绕过美方针对先进半导体的出口禁令
【核心事实细节】涉案方利用新加坡中转站规避贸易限制。
【各方立场与态度】揭露了复杂全球禁令背后的地下供应链漏洞。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] Suspected operative and Singapore-based network (Singapore-based logistics channels): Smuggling restricted high-end AI chips to China
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To bypass U.S. semiconductor export restrictions
[Regulatory & Investigation Focus] Exploitation of Singapore as a trade transit hub.
[Key Position & Outlook] Exposing vulnerabilities in global export control enforcement.

title: Japan’s Rapidus Is Said Likely to Miss Mass Production Deadline
title_en: Japan’s Rapidus Is Said Likely to Miss Mass Production Deadline
author: Takashi Mochizuki
content_snippet: Japanese government-backed startup Rapidus Corp. has fallen behind schedule on its high-stakes pledge to mass produce cutting-edge chips …
summary_en: Rapidus, a state-backed Japanese chip startup, has failed to produce functional SRAM, a critical step for its 2nm manufacturing roadmap. To meet the aggressive March 2028 mass production deadline, the company was required to finalize this stage by summer 2026.
title_zh: Rapidus两纳米芯片量产恐难产
summary_zh: 日本政府扶持的芯片厂商Rapidus在SRAM制造进度上严重滞后，恐危及2028年实现2纳米芯片量产的目标

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 日本政府力推的初创公司Rapidus在开发2纳米制程过程中，核心组件SRAM迟迟未能产出功能性样品。按照原本的产业化蓝图，Rapidus需在2026年夏季前完成此关键步骤，以确保能在2028年3月按期实现量产。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Rapidus, a state-backed Japanese chip startup, has failed to produce functional SRAM, a critical step for its 2nm manufacturing roadmap. To meet the aggressive March 2028 mass production deadline, the company was required to finalize this stage by summer 2026.

fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】日本芯片初创公司Rapidus在半导体先进制程研发中心：未能生产出可正常运行的SRAM样品，导致量产进度延宕
【起因与机理】为实现2028年大规模生产2纳米芯片的宏大国家目标，SRAM是必经的技术门槛
【核心事实细节】日本政府重点扶持芯片公司Rapidus。
【涉及范围与推进】面临2026年夏度的技术关键节点大考。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] Japanese chip startup Rapidus: Failed to produce functional SRAM, threatening its mass production schedule
[Root Cause & Mechanism] The component is essential for meeting the national goal of 2nm chip production by 2028
[Key Fact Detail] State-backed chipmaker Rapidus.
[Key Position & Outlook] Critical technical milestone due by summer 2026.

[Key Fact Detail] Alice Huang and partner Kang Wei identified by intelligence agencies.

title: Records show China's Northwestern Polytechnical University, which has close PLA ties, has access to Nvidia H200 AI chips despite being on a US export blacklist (Eduardo Baptista/Reuters)
title_en: Records show China's Northwestern Polytechnical University, which has close PLA ties, has access to Nvidia H200 AI chips despite being on a US export blacklist (Eduardo Baptista/Reuters)
author: Reuters
content_snippet: A Chinese university with deep ties to the People's Liberation Army bought Nvidia's powerful H200 AI chips last month despite …
summary_en: Northwestern Polytechnical University in China has reportedly procured Nvidia H200 AI chips via intermediaries, despite being on the US Entity List due to its military ties. This reveals significant gaps in global supply chain enforcement despite stringent export controls.
title_zh: 被美国拉黑的中国高校买入英伟达顶级芯片

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 中国西北工业大学近期被曝通过中间商采购了美国严禁出口的英伟达H200 AI高性能芯片。尽管该校因与军方的深度合作被列入美国实体清单，但全球芯片分销链的复杂性让这些禁令在现实执行中出现了明显的管控漏洞。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Northwestern Polytechnical University in China has reportedly procured Nvidia H200 AI chips via intermediaries, despite being on the US Entity List due to its military ties. This reveals significant gaps in global supply chain enforcement despite stringent export controls.

fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】西北工业大学在中国：绕过美方出口管制获取英伟达H200高性能AI芯片
【起因与机理】作为军工科研重点高校，其核心算力需求受制裁但仍需维持高水平技术研发
【核心事实细节】西北工业大学通过中间商获取高端芯片。
【各方立场与态度】供应链分销复杂性导致制裁执行面临巨大挑战。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] Northwestern Polytechnical University (NPU) (China): Procured high-performance Nvidia H200 chips through third-party channels despite US sanctions
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Urgent need for high-end computing power for military-linked R&D despite export restrictions
[Regulatory & Investigation Focus] NPU acquired high-end chips through middlemen.
[Industry Impact & Outlook] Supply chain complexity undermines enforcement efficacy.

title: Apple says its Apple Support Community forum will close permanently on November 20 and starting today the site is read-only and no longer accepts new posts (Marcus Mendes/9to5Mac)
title_en: Apple says its Apple Support Community forum will close permanently on November 20 and starting today the site is read-only and no longer accepts new posts (Marcus Mendes/9to5Mac)
author: 9to5Mac
content_snippet:
Users visiting the Apple Support Community tonight were greeted with a message informing them that the platform will permanently shut down on November 20. Here are the details.

If you have ever had a question or ran into a problem with an Apple product, chances are you have come across the Apple Support Community, the company’s official discussion forums where users from around the world help each other troubleshoot issues and share tips.

The platform has a history dating back to at least 1998

fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] Apple (Apple Support Community portal): Shutting down the forum permanently, read-only mode effective immediately

author: Tom's Hardware
content_snippet:
Our first look at Zen 6, both under the hood and in real-world applications.

Zen 6 uses TSMC’s N2P node, but it also comes with significant architectural changes under the hood. Within the core, a redesigned vector engine pushes AMD’s SIMD performance even higher, and it now natively supports half-precision FP16 instructions alongside full, 32-bit precision. It also splits integer schedulers within the execution engine, allowing for more instructions in flight through the core.

Across the die,
